📱 Mobile Support - Android APK & Cross-Platform Builds

✨ **Major New Features:**
- **📱 Android APK Support** - First mobile version for Movie Tracker
- **🔧 Mobile Tauri Features** - Touch-optimized interface
- **📦 Cross-Platform CI/CD** - Automated Android builds
- **🌐 Enhanced Distribution** - APK for direct Android downloads

🐛 **Bug Fixes:**
- Fixed toggle/switch component — dot no longer escapes track
- Fixed light mode not applying globally across all pages
- Fixed navigation customization not reflecting on navbar
- Fixed display settings (image quality, adult content) now functional
- Fixed keyboard shortcuts (G then H/M/S etc.)
- Fixed external links not opening in Tauri desktop app

🔧 **Technical Improvements:**
- **Mobile Configuration** - Tauri mobile features enabled
- **Android Build Target** - Automated APK generation
- **Cross-Platform Support** - Windows, macOS, Linux, Android
- **CI/CD Pipeline** - GitHub Actions ready for all platforms

📱 **Android Features:**
- **Touch Interface** - Mobile-optimized user experience
- **APK Distribution** - Direct download and installation
- **Google Play Ready** - Prepared for app store submission
- **Progressive Web App** - PWA capabilities included

🚀 **Version 1.3.2 - Mobile Milestone!**

This release marks Movie Tracker's expansion to mobile platforms with full cross-platform support.
